# Vendored crate: do not edit here

Byte-identical copy of `contrib/nfd-indexer` in
`geoffmccabe/Divi-Blockchain_6.9`. See `crates/dmt-indexer/VENDORED.md`; the same
rules apply.

Present here because `dvxp-scan` drives it: the scanner reads collectibles and
tokens in one pass over the chain, so the wallet cannot take one without the
other.
